## Context / Problem
Eleven `tests/scripts` files contain 60 audited prose blocks with repetition, history, or obvious narration. The scope and behavior were revalidated against immutable commit `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. The later `origin/main` advance to `10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396` does not touch these targets and is irrelevant to the audit citations. Since the superseded `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192` audit, the rotation and unblock blobs changed; the allowlist below includes every resulting block.

## Approach and identity
Condense only allowlisted ordinary comments and true leading docstrings. Preserve all runtime strings, prompts, fixtures, decorators, assertions, subprocess arguments, and executable behavior. Stable block IDs are `path::module-docstring`, `path::<qualified-symbol>-docstring`, or `path::<qualified-symbol>::comment(<opening words>)`; use `<module>` as the owner for module-level comments. The line spans below are immutable base citations, never the identity anchor. Adjacent blank-line cleanup is allowed only when attached to an edited block.

For each declared path, compare the immutable `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e:<path>` blob directly with the final leaf commit, even if the implementation branch is based on a later main. Parse with `type_comments=True`; remove leading docstrings only from `ast.Module`, `ast.ClassDef`, `ast.FunctionDef`, and `ast.AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining AST to match. This preserves runtime strings and every executable expression. Tokenize comments and compare every matched directive-bearing physical line plus any shebang byte-for-byte. The exact leaf changed-path set (`HEAD^..HEAD`) must equal the first-class `file_impact` set.

## Scope — immutable base citations
- `test_observability_memory_9ea3.py:1-22,151-162,237-245,282-294,372-383,410-417,461-468` — preserve measured/pessimistic host values, bounded service dimensions, parse-health heartbeat, and bounded non-streaming census.
- `test_observability_mirror_sync_bff5.py:1-16,150-157,171-177` — preserve every-path heartbeat, pessimistic comparison failure, and absent-log publication.
- `test_observability_rotation_2dc7.py:1-21,98-100,108-109,141,148-151,155,161,165,171` — preserve that a discarded journald cursor never re-announces survivors; an unmeasurable journal interval publishes nothing while the log-file counter may publish zero; reseeding cannot stall; the next new marker publishes exactly once; and recovery never re-reads the journal from the beginning.
- `test_reconciler_core_seam_clean_heldout.py:1-29,45-51,85-93,298-304,324-332,357-364,428-434` — preserve ownership census, live kill-switches, root precedence, wheel fallback, actionable failure, and the ordinary `85-93` read-via explanation.
- `test_reconciler_jira_seam_clean_heldout.py:1-32` — preserve the Jira seam-clean contract and live-per-call credential fallback.
- `test_residual_drain_seam_clean_heldout.py:1-50,83-85` — preserve exact residual ownership outcomes and the eight legitimate in-place reads.
- `test_reviewbot_entrypoint.py:61-70` — preserve the OpenSSH requirement and unsigned-event failure mode.
- `test_skill_mutation_sandbox_rule.py:1-17,29-31,52-55,168-174` — preserve mandatory sandboxing, self-contained profiles, scratch binding, capability probes, no-sandbox refusal, and removal-sensitive guards.
- `test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py:1-20` — preserve the observable zero-exception seam-clean contract.
- `test_summarize_ci_failures.py:1-15` — preserve timeout/failure/cancellation classification and the Gerrit message envelope.
- `test_ticket_unblock.py:1-22,32-37,58-69,133-135,143-151,170-172,178-185,202-204,210-218,237-239,245-261,359-361,367-378,402-412,434-436,442-450,525-532,555-563,587-595,756-757,773-775,783-792,845-854,887-899` — preserve dependency direction, burst/batch single-pass behavior, hidden-directory exclusion, tombstone precedence/fallback, canonical `graph._unblock._loader.reducer` ownership, and absence of the removed compatibility import.

Consumers are pytest collection/execution, CI test selection, and `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; the cold-start/offset suites cite the rotation contract. `_journald_stub.py` is now imported by the rotation test but is a dependency, not an edit target. No target-specific runtime docstring reader was found. No directive or shebang is present at the pinned base, but the guard must still require exact absence/preservation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes exactly the declared `file_impact` paths and only allowlisted prose blocks or their adjacent blank lines; the immutable-base normalized-AST/runtime/directive/shebang guard passes.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its listed contract and real consumers; repetition, chronology, obvious narration, and ornament are removed rather than moved.
- [ ] A reviewer who did not author the edits posts a leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block: stable block ID, immutable-before citation, final-commit citation (or `DELETED` plus surviving neighbor), preserved contract/consumer, `directives_exact`, before/after words, reviewer session, `semantic-preservation`, and `bloat-removal`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing rows, duplicate IDs, bad citations, or any non-PASS result block closure.
- [ ] The focused hermetic checks, `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and no-timeout worktree-venv `make verify` all pass. Collection-only checks never execute live Jira mutations.

## Verification
The authoritative executable commands and DD intent are recorded in first-class `verify_commands`. Do not replace `make verify` with `make lint`, and do not put a timeout around it.
